sources.title: Two issues on offense are holding the Broncos back
sources.description: This might surprise a lot of people, but one of those issues is not quarterback Bo Nix. In watching this offense it has become pretty clear that the passing game is being disrupted by Nix’s lack of trust in the interior line where Ben Powers and Luke Wattenberg are mostly responsible in pass protection.
